name: ARA
fix_description: Function 0x135b43e9 checks allowance of arg3 (a user address) to the contract, then performs operations on their behalf without verifying msg.sender == arg3 or any admin role. Anyone can call this function to operate on other users funds who have approved the contract. Fix: add require(msg.sender == arg3) or admin check.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step price-manipulation attack using a flash loan, two interactions with a protocol-specific vulnerable swap contract, and PancakeSwap V3 routing to distort and realize value. It is not deeply intricate, but it requires understanding the target contract’s special approved-address logic and the effect of temporary ARA price inflation, putting it beyond a simple obvious bug.
